config.timing_order: One warmed repetition of every operation, then independently shuffled operations in each measured repetition; serial, BLAS one thread.
config.scope: Engineering costs, not accuracy rankings, dedicated worst-case latency or asymptotic complexity proofs.
config.rank_scope: Real conditional codimension one and native proper-complex marginal rank one. General-rank moments are not substituted.
config.fixed_span_scope: Span80 and400 isolate matrix dimension from concentration; T64 generated data are a separate factor.
config.report_scope: Real N3 deterministic sphere integration; complex N3/8/16/32 independent threshold/check batches with finite exact-rejection proposal caps. Other report dimensions are explicitly not evaluated.
config.report_repetition_scope: Repeated clocks reuse the same predeclared seeded report draws; clock repetitions are not independent statistical datasets.
config.stream_scope: All endpoint streams assimilate64 snapshots and output once. Known v is supplied to both real conditional methods. GROUSE and SCM are marginal-model references only.
config.memory_scope: Exact persistent array bytes and separate Python/NumPy-tracked temporary-allocation peaks. Native BLAS/LAPACK workspaces and total process RSS are not measured.

hardware.timing: Serial process; CPU and wall clocks are separate. Other host activity can still affect wall clocks.
